children: STOXX SET FOR NEAR 1% WEEKLY FALL
It isn't the happiest of Fridays for European equities - the STOXX 600
is 0.1% lower on the day just over an hour into the trading day, which puts it on track for a roughly 1% weekly drop. That would also be its third weekly decline in the last four weeks.
is meanwhile down 0.3%, and the CAC
is just about in positive territory. They are all also headed for weekly falls.

Taking a look at sectors, chemicals (.SX4P) is leading declines, down 1%, while tech shares (.SX8P) were the biggest gainer, up 0.9%, as European semiconductor stocks - including Soitec, which was last up 4.9% to extend the previous session's 10% gain - rose.
Automobiles and parts (.SXAP) stocks are up 0.6%, as the sector has got a boost from Volkswagen
. Shares in the German automaker were last up 5.4% after its supervisory board struck a major turnaround agreement that averted an escalation with unions and shareholder Lower Saxony.
